problem_plain: Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance needed to transform its business through AI adoption to improve labour productivity in the face of Japan's declining and ageing population.
capability: Generative AI and agent-based AI technologies applied to support digital transformation, including AI-powered digital assistants to enhance staff capabilities and enable personalised insurance recommendations.
scale_outcomes: 10-year plan through March 2030; 300 next-generation leaders trained in digital and AI skills
reusable: Multi-year AI-driven business transformation approach combining technology deployment for product development and organisation-wide digital and AI talent development programmes; AI-powered digital assistant methodology for personalised customer engagement
summary: Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance and Veriden signed a multi-year contract under the "MY Mutual Way 2030" plan to drive business transformation through generative AI and agent-based AI technologies through March 2030. The initiative focuses on both product development through advanced technology adoption and talent development through an organisation-wide digital and AI training programme including 300 next-generation leaders.
